about_short_description.short_description: Truecaller is a mobile app that lets you see who's calling and block unwanted calls.

product.name: Truecaller App
product.description: A mobile communication and safety app that identifies unknown callers, blocks spam calls and messages, and provides calling, messaging, lookup, and contact-management features.

product.name: Truecaller Premium
product.description: A paid subscription that adds an ad-free Truecaller experience and enhanced caller-identification, spam-blocking, and safety capabilities.

product.name: Truecaller for Business
product.description: A business service that helps organizations use Truecaller-based identity and communication capabilities to make their outbound calls more recognizable and trustworthy.

product.name: Truecaller Advertising Platform
product.description: An advertising service that enables brands and organizations to reach Truecaller’s mobile user audience through advertising placements in the app and related services.

product.name: Truecaller Developer Platform
product.description: A developer service that provides tools and integrations for incorporating Truecaller identity and communication capabilities into applications and digital services.

product.name: Post-Call Actions
product.description: A Truecaller capability that lets consumers complete business-related tasks immediately after verified calls, including delivery changes, payments, callbacks, and KYC actions.
